<?php
function peerShift215() { global $late, $owner, $runner; $late = 99; $owner = null; $runner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerScopeBase215 { public static function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'WRONG;'; return $saved; } public function run() { global $owner, $late; return $owner->MiSsInG(first: (static::capture(...))($late, peerShift215()), later: false); } public function __destruct() { echo 'SCOPE-END;'; } }
class PeerScopeMid215 extends PeerScopeBase215 { public static function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'PRODUCER:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $saved; } }
class PeerScopeChild215 extends PeerScopeMid215 {}
class PeerBase215 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $alias; $alias = 0; echo 'MAGIC:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';', $arguments['first'], ':', $name, ';'; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived215 extends PeerBase215 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived215; $runner = new PeerScopeChild215; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $alias =& $late;
$value = $runner->run();
echo 'RETURN;'; unset($alias); unset($late); echo $value === false ? 'OK;' : 'BAD;'; echo 'AFTER;';
